title: A Mechanism for Mutual Fairness in Cooperative Games with Replicable Resources – Extended Version
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI alignment and the formalization of 'fairness' in AI agentic systems using cooperative game theory. It introduces and evaluates fairness axioms (such as the Balanced Reciprocity Axiom) and the ethical distribution of rewards in collaborative AI learning, which is a direct application of normative ethics and distributive justice to AI systems.
